shared_elements: forelimb or paw-like element below the head
single dominant creature filling the field
justification: Both depict a single animal-like creature dominated by its head with a prominent eye and some limb below, and both use incised hatched or textured infill on part of the body. But B is a highly conventionalised profile lion/griffin head with a crested mane of stacked feather-like lobes, curled locks, an open beak-like muzzle and a paw laid along the lower border within a framed panel with an inscribed band, while A is a three-dimensional, roughly modelled head-and-forelimb in near-frontal view with no comparable mane, beak, framing or ordered decorative registers.
